item.title: Dallas Pulse hosts panel and match for Girls & Women in Sports Day
item.description: Dallas PULSE will celebrate National Girls & Women in Sports Day with a pregame panel and match against the Omaha Supernovas on Feb. 5, featuring local women making an impact in the sports industry.

item.title: Ford Transit, Lincoln Navigator: Cheapest insurance in Texas
item.description: Texans purchasing 2024 or 2025 model vehicles can expect to pay more for full-coverage insurance.

item.title: Bad Bunny, NFL release official Super Bowl LX merch
item.description: We rounded up all the Bad Bunny Super Bowl gear to show who you’re really rooting for.

item.title: Dallas SWAT to represent U.S. at UAE SWAT Challenge 2026 in Dubai
item.description: The Dallas Police Department SWAT team will represent the United States at the UAE SWAT Challenge 2026 in Dubai, along with three other U.S. agencies, to compete in five demanding challenges designed to assess tactical precision, teamwork and physical readiness.

item.title: Bread Zeppelin opens in McKinney, Texas
item.description: Bread Zeppelin has opened in McKinney, Texas and is offering a special promotion of free Zeppelins and bowls on Wednesday, Feb. 4 until 3 p.m.

item.title: Local racer Ryan Yardley wins Porsche Carrera Cup Championship
item.description: Ryan Yardley, originally from New Zealand, moved to the U.S. in 2018 to pursue a racing career and has since won the Porsche Carrera Cup championship.

item.title: Great Wolf Lodge offers $26 room deal for one day only — Just use this promo code
item.description: Great Wolf Lodge is offering a one-day room sale on Feb. 6, 2026, with overnight stays priced at $26 per person for groups of four, valid at all U.S. locations and including access to the resort's indoor water park, dining and other attractions.

item.title: Fast & Functional: Racing go-karts at K1 Speed in Arlington
item.description: Brittany Breeding and Daniel Esteve went head to head racing go-karts at K1 Speed in Arlington, with Daniel getting some extra coaching ahead of the race.

item.title: Dallas artist presents "Elevar la cultura" at Latino Cultural Center
item.description: Dallas-raised artist Victor "Marka27" Quiñonez has unveiled a 22-foot-tall installation titled "Elevar La Cultura" at the Latino Cultural Center courtyard, consisting of 200 ice coolers and honoring immigrant labor, resilience and survival.

item.title: 'Who's a good guest?' debuts Feb. 4 with celebrity dog owners
item.description: BARK has launched a new video series, "Who's A Good Guest?", hosted by Josh Horowitz, featuring a celebrity lineup of dog parents and focusing on the relationships between celebrities and their pets, with each episode ending in a segment where guests pitch dog-inspired business ideas.
